intro.chaoEm: This is where your class tracks its goals for the year, and you track what you do each day.
intro.chaoNguoiLon: This is where the class tracks its goals for the year, and each student tracks what they do each day.
intro.chaoNgonNgu: To read in Vietnamese: press the gear icon at the top right and pick “Language”.
intro.cach1: Goals: the most important things the class wants to reach this year, in 4 areas: Knowledge, Leadership skills, Character, Physical well-being.
intro.cach2Em: Weekly promise: each week you promise one small thing, and at the end of the week you mark it Won or Lost yourself.
intro.cach2NguoiLon: Weekly promise: each week every student promises one small thing and marks it Won or Lost at the end.
intro.cach3Em: Lead measures: what you do each day to keep the promise, like reading 15 minutes. Tick the day’s box once done.
intro.cach3NguoiLon: Lead measures: what each student does daily to keep the promise. They tick the day’s box once done.
intro.cach4Em: Progress ring: a percentage that tells you whether you are on pace or behind.
intro.cach4NguoiLon: Progress ring: a percentage that shows whether the class and each student are on pace or behind.
intro.cach5Em: Buddy meeting: each week you sit with your buddy, look back at the week, then promise next week’s work.

teacher.title: You're a homeroom teacher
teacher.b1: Class page: scoreboard, competition rank, 4-area goal rings.
teacher.b2: Attendance: tick the whole class fast, adjust a few, saved instantly.
teacher.b3: Goals: set the class goal and your own; students set their promises and measures. Progress comes from their own ticks.
teacher.b4: Roster: set an “Attendance leader” so a student can mark attendance (today only).

student.title: You're a student
student.b1: Open “My board” to find everything: today’s mood, your goals, promises and measures to tick.
student.b2: Pick a face each day in “How are you today?”. That is also your attendance.
student.b3: If you are the “Attendance leader”: mark attendance for the class (today only).

parent.title: You're a parent
parent.b1: Open Report: only your child’s data, attendance plus weekly goal progress.
parent.b2: Pick a week to see per-area results and your child’s reflection.
parent.b3: You cannot see other students’ data.

principal.title: You're school leadership
principal.b1: Campus report: classes in your campus, competition score plus today’s attendance.

admin.title: You're an administrator
admin.b1: Create campuses and classes, assign homeroom teachers.
admin.b2: Invite new users (pick role + class): assigned on first sign-in.
admin.b3: Change roles, disable or delete users; invite parents and link children.

pending.title: Account pending access
pending.b1: Contact your school administrator to be assigned a role.

intro.xong1: To replay this guide: press the gear icon at the top right and pick “Guide”.
